fb54230f27c05350.raw_summary: Deutsche Bank’s macro strategy team notes that Brent Oil remains supported by geopolitical tensions and supply concerns. Comments from President Trump about the Strait of Hormuz have reinforced fears of a prolonged disruption, driving prices higher overnight.
fb54230f27c05350.summary: Brent oil price increased due to supply concerns, affecting UK businesses with USD-priced oil imports. Higher costs may squeeze margins, making it a good time to discuss FX strategies.
